title: changdong1687/1Step-WAM
abstract: # 1Step-WAM: Your World Action Model but Faster Using 1-Step Action Generation [ ](https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/blob/main/LICENSE)  [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15625)  ## 💡 Overview The deployment of World Action Model (WAM) is often limited by iterative action denoising and serial video-action execution. **1Step-WAM** turns a pretrained multi-step WAM into a one-step action generator while retaining the original backbone. 1Step-WAM combines three complementary components: 1. **Lightweight velocity calibration.** A small calibration head corrects the initial ActionDiT velocity prediction toward the multi-step teacher endpoint while the WAM backbone stays frozen. 2. **Bandwidth-constrained action decoding.** A temporal DCT projection retains low-frequency action modes and suppresses residual prediction error. 3. **Joint video--action execution.** Each action block starts as soon as its required visual K/V cache is available, overlapping action decoding with video prefill. ## ✨ Highlights - ⚡ **One action-generation pass:** replaces iterative action denoising with a calibrated single forward pass. - 🪶 **Parameter efficient:** trains only a 13.4M-parameter calibration head. - 🔧 **Backbone general:** evaluated on FastWAM, ImageWAM, and Kairos. - 🚀 **End-to-end acceleration:** achieves **5.98x-24.84x** speedup on a single NVIDIA L40 GPU while preserving most of the original task success rate. ## 📊 Evaluation Results ### RoboTwin On RoboTwin, 1Step-WAM achieves the best average success rate among the evaluated one-step methods for all three backbones, with end-to-end speedups of **7.44x**, **5.98x**, and **24.84x** for FastWAM, ImageWAM, and Kairos, respectively. ### LIBERO Across the four LIBERO suites, 1Step-WAM closely matches the multi-step policies on FastWAM and ImageWAM, and reaches highest mean success (**97.2%**) with the Kairos backbone. ### 🤖 Real-World Tasks We evaluate FastWAM-based policies on an AIRBOT Play robot across Pick Place, Stack
abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）的部署常受限于迭代式动作去噪和串行视频-动作执行。1Step-WAM 将预训练的多步 WAM 转变为一步动作生成器，同时保留原始骨干网络。1Step-WAM 结合了三个互补组件：1. 轻量级速度校准。一个小型校准头将初始 ActionDiT 速度预测校正到多步教师端点，而 WAM 骨干保持冻结。2. 带宽约束的动作解码。时间 DCT 投影保留低频动作模式并抑制残差预测误差。3. 联合视频-动作执行。每个动作块在其所需的视觉 K/V 缓存可用时立即开始，将动作解码与视频预填充重叠。亮点包括：单次动作生成前向传播替代迭代去噪；仅训练 13.4M 参数的校准头；在 FastWAM、ImageWAM 和 Kairos 上评估；在单块 NVIDIA L40 GPU 上实现 5.98x-24.84x 加速，同时保留大部分原始任务成功率。在 RoboTwin 上，1Step-WAM 在三个骨干上均取得评估的一步方法中最佳平均成功率，端到端加速分别为 7.44x、5.98x 和 24.84x。在 LIBERO 四个套件上，1Step-WAM 在 FastWAM 和 ImageWAM 上接近多步策略，并在 Kairos 骨干上达到最高平均成功率（97.2%）。在真实世界任务中，基于 FastWAM 的策略在 AIRBOT Play 机器人上评估了拾取放置和堆叠任务。
tldr_zh: 将多步世界动作模型转为一步生成，大幅加速且保持成功率。
cover_zh: 世界动作模型还能一步生成？速度飙升但成功率几乎不掉！
